opening.text: Emma, the newest intern, approaches your desk with a stack of papers. She's clearly trying to make a good impression.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: emma
segments.text: Senator, I've prepared the constituent correspondence you requested. I highlighted the most urgent ones in yellow.

choices.text: "Thank you, Emma. I appreciate your initiative."

segments.speaker: emma
segments.text: She beams at your thanks, clearly pleased. "I'm happy to help. Is there anything else you need before the press conference?"

choices.text: "Actually, could you grab me a coffee?"

segments.speaker: emma
segments.text: Her face lights up at your encouragement. "Thank you, Senator. I'm really learning a lot here." She lingers a moment longer than necessary.

choices.text: "You're a quick learner. I'm glad you're here."

segments.speaker: emma
segments.text: "I'll be at my desk if you need anything." She gives you one last look before heading back to her workspace.

consequences.high_attraction: Emma may have complicated feelings (power dynamic issues in Chapter 6-7)
consequences.high_respect: Emma will be loyal and hardworking throughout
consequences.low_engagement: Emma may not go above and beyond later
